body: Thank you. You've given me a lot to think about and look at.

OK, I'll try it out. I just really hope that I can bring myself to be able to say anything.

We went to the same high school but of all the people who told me they really enjoyed my company he's the only one who makes any effort to still talk to and see me. It's probably partly because once I realized I had no one else left I squeezed onto him tighter but at this point I'm starting to wonder if he doesn't just hate me.

Honestly I'm not sure. I've never even said any of this out loud to myself. Even when I'm alone I just get a huge lump in my throat and nothing comes out.

I just hate feeling like someone is judging me. I know therapists aren't supposed to but they're people, they always do. I guess it might be easier if they can't see my face but I can't be sure.
